info.name: Multi-Business Appointment Booking API
info.description: Postman collection covering every registered API route. Protected requests send the JWT as the accessToken cookie populated by role login requests.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Run the login for the role you need. The JWT is saved to both accessToken and that role's token variable; role folders use their matching token.

item.name: Business Owner - Scheduling and Pricing
item.description: Set working hours and staff availability before creating a booking. Booking rule and pricing settings are business-specific.

item.name: Customer - Multi-Service Bookings
item.description: Sign in as Customer. Booking response includes the automatically assigned staff for each service and pricing/assignment explanations.

item.name: Check time and price (no booking created)

request.description: Checks schedule and returns assignment and pricing explanations without saving a booking.

item.name: Create a separate booking for cancellation example
Staff - Assigned Appointments
item.description: The seeded sample staff account has no StaffProfile; use a staff account created for a business to call these endpoints.

item.name: Login as newly created staff member
Cleanup (optional; run last)
item.description: Destructive soft-delete/deactivation examples. Run only after completing the other requests.

request.description: Soft-delete the category. Run only after all business examples are complete.
